events.text: The Evidence Explorer first showed draft classifications for passages of both published essays. They are drafts and have not been editorially reviewed.

events.title: Bibliographic records checked for three sources of “Is Human Consciousness Connected to Artificial Intelligence?”
events.text: The Research Observatory retrieved Crossref and DataCite records for Turing (1950), Searle (1980) and Butlin et al. (2023) and checked them against their DOIs.

events.title: Existing source-inspection records imported into the Source Registry
events.text: Notes already kept by the Museum, Theory Chamber, Lexicon and shared research index were copied into the Source Registry with their origin. Sources with no such note were left as Verification Incomplete.
